content.text: All eight preferred elements are satisfied in §§ 22.1–22.2; no other audit/inspection right binds Customer (§ 23 has no operative text).

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 meets the preferred position in full: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period (22.1), require at least thirty days' prior written notice (22.1), occur during normal business hours (22.1), are conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1), Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent (22.2), and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly (22.2). Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no operative audit right binding Customer, and no other inspection or verification right against Customer appears in the document. No redline required.
